A kitchen should make cooking, storage, and everyday living easier, not more frustrating. 2 Brothers Kitchen and Bath Remodeling provides custom kitchen remodeling in Haltom City for homeowners who want a space designed around how they actually live. From layout improvements and cabinetry to countertops, finishes, and complete renovations, every detail is planned to improve both function and appearance. Whether your kitchen feels outdated, cramped, or simply no longer fits your needs, the right remodel can turn it into a space you enjoy using every day. Upgrade the heart of your home with a kitchen built for you. Contact 2 Brothers Kitchen and Bath Remodeling today to discuss your remodeling project.

From the owner
What edge should I pick for my marble countertop? The edge profile is the shape cut into the front edge of the slab, and it changes how a marble countertop looks and wears in an Agua Dulce kitchen. A simple eased or slightly rounded edge gives a clean, modern look. Decorative shapes like an ogee add more detail and suit traditional kitchens. Marble is softer than granite, so sharp square corners are more likely to chip over time. A softer rounded edge holds up better in a busy kitchen and feels safer around kids. Thicker slabs also handle detailed edges more cleanly than thin ones. The edge is easy to overlook next to color and veining, but it is hard to change once the slab is cut. Picking it early keeps the finished kitchen closer to the plan. Pro Tip: Ask to see your chosen edge on a sample of the same marble, since the shape reads differently on veined stone than it does in a catalog photo.

How to Find Affordable Contractors in Sioux Falls Without Compromising Quality? Affordable does not mean the lowest bid. It means receiving honest, itemized pricing for the scope of work you actually need, so there are no surprises mid-project. A quote that looks cheap upfront often grows once change orders, excluded trades, and permits are added later. Start by checking third-party verified reviews on platforms like Google or Trustindex, where ratings cannot be self-reported. Look for patterns across detailed reviews mentioning on-time delivery, clear communication, honest pricing, and quality craftsmanship. Before hiring, ask key questions: Who is your point of contact? Are permits included? How are mid-project cost changes handled? Are trade partners licensed? Any scope adjustment should be documented in writing before work proceeds. Hiring a full-service general contractor also saves coordination costs, as one team manages scheduling, sequencing, and trade partners from start to finish. Old Santa Fe Trail Whole House Remodel: Luxury Living Meets Timeless Southwest Design What does a luxury whole-house remodel in Santa Fe look like when modern elegance meets traditional New Mexico charm? For this 5,800 sq. ft. Old Santa Fe Trail remodel, Fabuwallous Solutions LLC transformed a stunning 1.5-acre property into a sophisticated retreat featuring panoramic views of the Jemez and Ortiz Mountains. The renovation includes a custom chef's kitchen with quartz countertops, a butler's pantry, elegant dining spaces, six fireplaces, two spacious guest suites, and a 1,200 sq. ft. primary suite with separate bathrooms. A resort-inspired outdoor living area with a lap pool and mountain views completes the experience. Blending Asian-inspired design with traditional Santa Fe style, this whole-house renovation reflects exceptional craftsmanship, thoughtful space planning, and luxurious functionality. As an experienced Santa Fe general contractor, Fabuwallous specializes in luxury home remodeling Santa Fe, custom kitchens, high-end residential renovations, Santa Fe style interior design, and complete home transformations throughout Northern New Mexico. There's a point in every kitchen where it stops looking like a construction site and starts looking like somebody's home. This one, in Middlesex County, NJ, reached it today. The white uppers are hung, the base cabinets and the island are going in, and the floors are already down. Stand in the middle of it now and you can picture exactly where the morning coffee happens. This kitchen is ours from end to end — we sold it, we supplied it, and our own crew is installing it. One team from the first measurement to the last door adjustment. It's a slower way to run a business, and a much better way to stand behind the result. Countertops and final trim are next. We'll share the finished room soon. Thinking about your own kitchen? The process often spans 3-6 weeks, depending on the scope of the project and your specific needs. The key steps include an initial consultation to discuss your vision, detailed planning and design, obtaining necessary permits, and finally, the actual construction work. Restoration isn't just about drying things out: it’s a science. When property damage occurs, following IICRC guidelines is the only way to ensure a safe and healthy environment. In the Dallas / Fort Worth area, I often see "quick fixes" that unfortunately lead to long-term mold issues. True Water Damage Restoration requires more than just fans. It involves high-tech thermal imaging to identify hidden moisture and the use of professional biologic agents to ensure the containment area is properly mitigated. Whether it is Smoke Damage Cleanup or a major water leak, adhering to these science-based standards is the only professional benchmark that matters. My focus is always on operational excellence and ensuring that every property is returned to pre-loss condition correctly the first time. Following the right protocols isn't just about the work; it's about the safety of the families living in these homes. How do you vet the professional standards of the contractors working on your property?

From the owner
Everyone gets excited about what their home will look like after a remodel. But there's another question worth asking before construction starts: How are we going to live here while it's happening? If you're remodeling your kitchen, where will you make breakfast? If you're updating a bathroom, will another one be available? What about the kids, the pets, or someone who works from home? These things are easy to overlook when you're busy choosing cabinets, flooring, and fixtures. Before starting a remodeling project, talk through which rooms will be affected, what your family will still need access to, and how your daily routines might change. Maybe that means setting up a temporary coffee station, moving everyday essentials somewhere accessible, or planning ahead for noisy construction days. A renovation will disrupt your routine. But understanding what to expect can make a big difference. Because planning a remodel isn't only about how your home will look when it's finished. It's also about making the process more manageable for the people living there. — MD&CD Design & Build Image: Illustrative renovation imagery, not an MD&CD project.

The niche is one of those details that can make a shower look clean and custom — but only if it’s planned correctly. Before you hire a contractor in Fontana, ask for three things. The license number. Not the word "licensed", the actual number. The right lighting can make a room feel more spacious, welcoming, and functional without changing its entire layout. Modern fixtures offer a wide range of styles, from clean-lined ceiling lights and recessed lighting to pendant fixtures, wall sconces, and contemporary chandeliers. Choosing the right combination can improve visibility while creating a more comfortable atmosphere for cooking, working, relaxing, or entertaining. Instead of relying on one bright overhead light, many rooms benefit from layered lighting that combines general illumination with task and accent lighting. The result can be a more balanced space that suits different activities throughout the day. Before selecting fixtures, consider the room's size, ceiling height, existing electrical layout, and the type of light you need. Warm or neutral color temperatures can create different moods, while dimmers and compatible LED bulbs can provide greater flexibility and energy efficiency. Fixture weight, mounting requirements, and electrical connections must also be considered during installation. Trent's Handyman and General Construction can help homeowners explore lighting updates and coordinate suitable improvements for their living spaces. Whether you are refreshing a single room or updating lighting throughout your home, thoughtful fixture selection can make a meaningful difference. Contact Trent's Handyman and General Construction today to discuss your lighting project and explore ways to brighten your home.

A licensed contractor has met the requirements set by the state. An insured contractor has taken responsibility for the risks of the work. Before work starts, we build a 3D view of your new kitchen, showing layout, cabinets, counters, and lighting, so you can change expensive decisions while changing them is still free.
